# CV Optimizer — Design System

## Stack

- **Tailwind CSS v4** — utility-first CSS
- **shadcn/ui** — copy-paste component library
- **Radix UI** — accessible primitives
- **Geist Font** — clean, modern typography

---

## Installation

### shadcn/ui Setup

```bash
# Initialize shadcn/ui
npx shadcn@latest init

# Install core components
npx shadcn@latest add button card badge dialog toast
npx shadcn@latest add dropdown-menu avatar separator
npx shadcn@latest add input label textarea
npx shadcn@latest add progress skeleton
```

### Configuration

```typescript
// components.json (generated by shadcn init)
{
  "style": "default",
  "tailwind": {
    "config": "tailwind.config.ts",
    "css": "src/app/globals.css",
    "baseColor": "slate",
    "cssVariables": true
  },
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils"
  }
}
```

---

## Color Palette

### Base Colors (Slate)
Using Tailwind's slate palette for neutral tones.

| Token | Light | Dark | Usage |
|-------|-------|------|-------|
| `background` | white | slate-950 | Page background |
| `foreground` | slate-900 | slate-50 | Primary text |
| `muted` | slate-100 | slate-800 | Muted backgrounds |
| `muted-foreground` | slate-500 | slate-400 | Secondary text |
| `border` | slate-200 | slate-800 | Borders |
| `ring` | slate-400 | slate-300 | Focus rings |

### Accent Colors

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `primary` | slate-900 | Primary buttons, links |
| `primary-foreground` | white | Text on primary |
| `secondary` | slate-100 | Secondary buttons |
| `secondary-foreground` | slate-900 | Text on secondary |
| `destructive` | red-500 | Delete, errors |
| `success` | green-500 | Success states |
| `warning` | amber-500 | Warnings |

### Brand Colors (Future)

```css
:root {
  --brand-primary: #2563eb; /* Blue-600 */
  --brand-secondary: #7c3aed; /* Violet-600 */
}
```

## Typography

### Font Family
```css
--font-sans: var(--font-geist-sans), system-ui, sans-serif;
--font-mono: var(--font-geist-mono), monospace;
```

### Scale

| Class | Size | Weight | Usage |
|-------|------|--------|-------|
| `text-2xl font-semibold` | 24px | 600 | Page titles |
| `text-lg font-semibold` | 18px | 600 | Section headers |
| `text-base` | 16px | 400 | Body text |
| `text-sm` | 14px | 400 | Secondary text |
| `text-xs` | 12px | 400 | Captions, labels |

---

## Spacing

Using Tailwind's default spacing scale:

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `space-1` | 4px | Tight spacing |
| `space-2` | 8px | Small gaps |
| `space-4` | 16px | Standard gaps |
| `space-5` | 20px | Card padding |
| `space-6` | 24px | Section gaps |
| `space-10` | 40px | Large sections |

## Components

### Button Variants

```tsx
// Primary (default)
<Button>Purchase Credits</Button>

// Secondary
<Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>

// Outline
<Button variant="outline">View Details</Button>

// Ghost
<Button variant="ghost">Learn More</Button>

// Destructive
<Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>

// Sizes
<Button size="sm">Small</Button>
<Button size="default">Default</Button>
<Button size="lg">Large</Button>
```

### Card

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Credits Balance</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Your current credit balance</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    <p className="text-4xl font-bold">125</p>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button>Top Up</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

### Badge

```tsx
<Badge>Default</Badge>
<Badge variant="secondary">Secondary</Badge>
<Badge variant="outline">Outline</Badge>
<Badge variant="destructive">Error</Badge>
```

## Dashboard Widget Pattern

```tsx
// Base widget structure
function Widget({ title, description, children, action }) {
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between pb-2">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">{title}</CardTitle>
          {description && (
            <CardDescription className="text-xs">{description}</CardDescription>
          )}
        </div>
        {action}
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>{children}</CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// Usage
<Widget
  title="Credits Balance"
  description="Available for CV optimization"
  action={<Button size="sm">Top Up</Button>}
>
  <p className="text-3xl font-bold">125</p>
  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">≈ 125 pages</p>
</Widget>
```

---

## Layout

### Dashboard Grid

```tsx
// 2-column on desktop, 1-column on mobile
<div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
  <CreditsWidget />
  <SpendingWidget />
  <StatsWidget />
  <ActivityWidget />
</div>
```

### Page Layout

```tsx
<main className="container mx-auto py-6 space-y-8">
  <header className="space-y-1">
    <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold">Dashboard</h1>
    <p className="text-muted-foreground">
      Overview of your CV optimization activity
    </p>
  </header>

  <section className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
    {/* Widgets */}
  </section>

  <section className="space-y-4">
    <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Recent Activity</h2>
    {/* Activity list */}
  </section>
</main>
```

## Dark Mode (Phase 2)

Already supported via CSS variables:

```css
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --background: #0a0a0a;
    --foreground: #ededed;
  }
}
```

shadcn/ui components automatically respect dark mode when using CSS variables.

## Icons

Recommend **Lucide React** (default with shadcn):

```bash
npm install lucide-react
```

```tsx
import { CreditCard, TrendingUp, FileText, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

<CreditCard className="h-4 w-4" />
```

## Accessibility

- All interactive elements have focus states
- Color contrast meets WCAG AA
- Proper heading hierarchy
- ARIA labels where needed
- Keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader friendly
